## Singapore Family Packing Snapshot
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/cloud-sun.svg

Hot, humid, and rain-prone all week: highs of **31–34°C**, warm nights, and **high UV (8–11)**. Pack light, quick-dry, and shower-ready items for a family with kids.

## 5-Day Weather-Aware Packing Checklist
- **5–6 lightweight outfits per person**: breathable T-shirts, shorts, dresses, and one nicer set for dinners.
- **1 light long-sleeve layer each**: for strong sun, over-air-conditioned malls, and evening breezes.
- **Quick-dry underwear and socks**: enough for daily changes in humid weather.
- **Packable rain jacket or compact umbrella per adult**: July has a high chance of showers, especially on 7/11, 7/13, and 7/15.
- **Waterproof sandals or comfy sneakers**: choose shoes that dry fast after sudden rain.
- **Sun protection kit**: high-SPF sunscreen, hats, sunglasses, and lip balm with SPF.
- **Refillable water bottles**: one per person to stay hydrated in the heat.
- **Kid rain gear**: child-sized ponchos or mini umbrellas, plus a spare change of clothes in the day bag.
- **Kid comfort items**: snacks, wipes, tissues, hand sanitizer, and a small first-aid kit.
- **Day bag essentials**: zip pouches or dry bags for phones, chargers, tickets, and wet clothes.
- **Pool/beach extras if needed**: swimwear, rash guards, and a small microfiber towel.
- **Mosquito protection**: repellent and after-bite relief, especially for evening outings.

## Quick Actions
- Action: [Button: Check Weather](https://www.weather.gov.sg/)
- Action: [Button: Family Travel Gear](https://www.komoot.com/guide/)

## Sources
- Forecast provided in your prompt: https://www.weather.gov.sg/
- Sun and UV guidance: https://www.who.int/news-room/questions-and-answers/item/radiation-the-ultraviolet-(uv)-index
